thread.content: This may have been completed already by an agent outside of swarm manager, so investigate and see what’s still relevant and any remaining work that might need to be done

Investigation complete. Significant prior art exists in prompt-manager that changes the scope of this initiative.

**Key finding:** A `Meta Optimization Team` has been active in prompt-manager since 2026-02-09 with 6 roles (Skill Optimizer, Toolchain Validator, Team & Agent Optimizer, **Run Introspector**, Meta Contrarian, Debt Curator). It mines skills/agents/toolchain/runs and produces hypotheses-with-citations — exactly the pattern this initiative proposes. What it does **not** mine: completed-initiative feedback/review/handoff data.

**Also:** The foundation's `proposal-review.tsx` component (stateless, generic, mutation-list driven) already exists and is reused across feedback + upcoming research surfaces — meaning the UI item is largely redundant.

Net effect: the initiative is still relevant, but should be re-scoped from "build a new team" to "add an Initiative Introspector role to the existing Meta Optimization Team." The UI item can be archived.

Quantify volume, freshness, and structural quality of initiative-specific artifacts; output a go/no-go on adding an Initiative Introspector role, with the minimum signal threshold (e.g. ≥N completed initiatives with full trails) needed before extension.",
